passage.label: created you why not believe; seen emit you create We Creator; decreed death not outdone change likenesses produce form not know; known first creation remember; seen sow you grow We grower; willed make debris wonder debt deprived; seen water drink you brought clouds We bring down; willed bitter why not grateful; seen fire ignite you produced tree We producer; made reminder provision travelers; exalt name Lord Most Great

arabicExcerpts.text: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ حُطَٰمٗا فَظَلۡتُمۡ تَفَكَّهُونَ
ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنزَلۡتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُزۡنِ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنزِلُونَ
لَوۡ نَشَآءُ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ أُجَاجٗا فَلَوۡلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ
ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنشَأۡتُمۡ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنشِـُٔونَ

mainSubject.label: Four evidentiary challenges drawn from ordinary human experience: creation itself demanding belief; the emitted seed whose creator is Allah not man, with death decreed and forms replaceable beyond human knowledge though the first creation is already known; the sown seed whose grower is Allah, capable of reducing it to debris leaving them wondering over debt and deprivation; the drinking water brought down from clouds by Allah, capable of being made bitter, prompting the gratitude question; the ignited fire whose tree Allah produced, made a reminder and provision for travellers — closing with the command to exalt the name of the Lord, the Most Great

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the peace-only speech of the forerunners (26) before the companions-of-the-right block opens (27); P2 ends with the Zaqqum accommodation verdict (56) before the four evidentiary challenges begin (57); P3 runs through seed, sowing, water and fire to the first exaltation command (57-74); P4 covers the star-oath, protected Register, deathbed scene, threefold outcome and the closing exaltation (75-96).
